title.en: texas renaissance festival on thanksgiving friday.

line.en: open 9 am to 8 pm, gates close at 7 pm. the festival is outside town, so plan a full day; it runs to sunday 29 november.
line.de: geöffnet 9 bis 20 uhr, einlass endet um 19 uhr. das fest liegt außerhalb der stadt, also einen ganzen tag einplanen; es läuft bis sonntag, 29. november.
line.tr: 09:00'dan 20:00'ye açık, girişler 19:00'da kapanıyor. festival şehir dışında, tam bir gün planla; 29 kasım pazar gününe kadar sürüyor.

sparks.why: Texas Renaissance Festival, Thanksgiving Friday 27 Nov 9 am to 8 pm per Visit Conroe and other listings; the season runs to 29 Nov 2026 (Houstonia's October end date is treated as an error).
